en: Black‑and‑white aerial/raised view over a river bend with numerous barges and a small passenger steamer. A long steel truss bridge with stone piers crosses the river in the foreground. On both banks there are quays, rail tracks, and mid‑European style houses and villas with steep tiled roofs. In the background a high rocky hill with a sheer cliff dominates the scene, with rail lines and a road curving around its base and more town buildings and distant hills beyond. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
